hooks.name: destructive-shell-guard
hooks.description: Lightweight agent-side guardrail appended before shell tool use

action.prompt: Guardrail: if this shell command is destructive (cdk destroy, deploy.sh --delete, rm -rf, git push --force, emptying S3 buckets, deleting log groups or databases), verify the user explicitly requested that teardown in this session before running it. Migrations are deploys, never teardowns.

hooks.name: log-changes-round
hooks.description: On-demand: append the current change-set to CHANGES.md per steering/change-logging.md

action.prompt: Append the current change-set as a new 'Round N' entry to the project's CHANGES.md, following steering/change-logging.md exactly (next round number, current local timestamp with offset, one bullet per discrete change).
